subject: Exec recap: Pilot goals, risks, and procurement path (AuroraMed)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Chen <tom.chen@auroramed.com>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@auroramed.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Exec recap: Pilot goals, risks, and procurement path (AuroraMed)

Hi Tom / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today — below is a short executive-facing recap and proposed next steps so we can align your leadership and procurement teams. I copied Laura and Aditya to keep the AE/manager loop intact.

Attendees:
- Tom Chen (AuroraMed, Head of Data & Analytics)
- Priya Nair (AuroraMed, Procurement)
- Marissa Cole (Redwood Inference)
- Aditya Rao (Redwood, Solutions)

Key pain points you shared:
- High per-token inference cost on current vendor + unpredictable latency during peak batch runs.
- Inability to run models in VPC for sensitive PHI workflows.
- Limited observability into token-level cost and quality regressions for production pipelines.

Business goals / success metrics for pilot (6-8 weeks):
- Reduce inference cost per 1M tokens by >= 30% while matching generation quality.
- Achieve 95th percentile tail latency < 400ms for 4k context LLMs under typical load.
- Validate VPC/private deployment for PHI use-cases and confirm KMS/HSM integration.

Procurement path & timeline (as discussed):
- Pilot approval from leadership by end of Q2 (target: 2027-06-30).
- Procurement to review SOW and standard terms; Priya to advise on required PO/contract steps.
- If pilot meets metrics, scale to Reserved/Dedicated capacity and contract in Q3.

Risks & escalation items:
- SOC 2 evidence and security questionnaire responses required before pilot start (we attached SOC2-summary.pdf).
- Data residency & encryption requirements for PHI - need confirmation of allowed regions and KMS integration timeline.
- Any deviation on timeline from procurement may push pilot start to late Q3.

Proposed next steps (owners & dates):
1) Marissa: Share SOW draft + SOC2 summary (attached) and HubSpot packet - today (15 Apr).
2) Priya: Confirm procurement contact, required PO terms, and timeline - by Fri 2027-04-22.
3) Aditya: Technical follow-up (network diagram, VPC architecture, KMS options) - by Mon 2027-04-26.
4) Leadership sync (Tom + Redwood execs) - schedule week of 2027-04-26 if procurement confirms path.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW-draft.pdf, SOC2-summary.pdf
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/auroramed

If this looks right I can circulate the SOW to your procurement team and book a short leadership call to secure pilot sign-off.

Thanks -
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

From: Tom Chen <tom.chen@auroramed.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@auroramed.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 15:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec recap: Pilot goals, risks, and procurement path (AuroraMed)

Marissa - thanks for the clear recap. High level: correct on goals and timeline. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement: Priya is on cc and will be the point of contact for contracts/POs. Priya, can you confirm typical lead time for a small pilot (SOW + PO)?
- Security: We need SOC2 Type II evidence and a short attestation on data residency for PHI. The SOC2-summary you sent looks good; please also confirm whether we can keep keys in our KMS (we prefer customer-managed keys).
- Budget: Leadership has approved a pilot budget in the mid-five figures; if the pilot hits the success metrics, we expect to move to a reserved capacity commitment.

One ask: loop in our cloud/network engineer for the VPC peering discussion once Aditya has the initial architecture notes.

Next steps from AuroraMed:
- Priya to confirm procurement timeline by 2027-04-22 (cc'd).
- I'll book a 30-min follow-up with our VP of Product and you if procurement sign-off is on track.

Thanks -
Tom
Head of Data & Analytics | AuroraMed
tom.chen@auroramed.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Chen <tom.chen@auroramed.com>, Priya Nair <priya.nair@auroramed.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec recap: Pilot goals, risks, and procurement path (AuroraMed)

Tom / Priya - great, appreciate the quick confirmation.

Priya - thanks in advance for confirming procurement lead times. To make that easier I've attached the SOW draft and a one-page summary of SOC2 controls (SOC2-summary.pdf). We can accommodate customer-managed KMS; Aditya will outline the KMS/HSM options and the network design for VPC peering.

Escalation path (if we hit any blocker):
- Security blockers (SOC2 evidence, data residency) -> escalate to Redwood Security lead (cc Laura) for committed turnaround on evidence.
- Procurement delays -> I will escalate to our Head of Revenue (laura.bennett) to prioritize contract review and PO processing.
- Technical showstoppers during pilot -> direct escalation to Aditya + pre-scheduled engineering office hours (we recommend two 1-hr slots/week during pilot).

Action items (confirming owners/dates):
- Marissa: Share final SOW + DocuSign envelope by EOD 2027-04-16. (Attachment: Redwood_SOW-draft.pdf)
- Priya: Confirm procurement steps & expected PO date by 2027-04-22.
- Aditya: Deliver VPC/KMS architecture notes by 2027-04-26 and propose initial engineering office hours.

If it helps I can schedule the leadership readout for the week of 2027-04-26 now and we'll cancel if procurement isn't ready - thoughts?

Thanks again - looking forward to getting this moving.

-
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182
